name: Roze AI Inc. Common Shares
summary: Roze AI, formerly Rozeta Tech, leverages ICT, AI, IoT, and big data to pioneer the world's first AI-based fire forecast system. This predictive technology empowers communities and industries to anticipate fire risks in advance, aiming to safeguard lives and property. The company's capabilities have been validated through deployments in major public and industrial facilities in South Korea, and it is expanding its global footprint with subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Singapore, and Bangladesh.
